facebookresearch_npm/npm/dstore.py.create_datastore_for_wikipedia: create a DataStore instance to load Wikipedia corpus data with embeddings and FAISS index for nearest neighbor search
facebookresearch_npm/npm/dstore.py.search_embeddings_with_faiss: search the FAISS index with query embeddings to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor token indices and scores
facebookresearch_npm/npm/dstore.py.load_token_embeddings: load precomputed token embeddings from a model directory as memory-mapped float16 numpy arrays
facebookresearch_npm/npm/dstore.py.train_faiss_index: train an IVFPQ FAISS index on a sampled subset of embeddings using GPU acceleration
facebookresearch_npm/npm/dstore.py.get_context_for_token: get the decoded text context around a specific token index using a provided decode function

facebookresearch_npm/npm/model.py.load_single_model_from_hf_hub: load a SingleModel from HuggingFace Hub using checkpoint path like facebook/npm-single
facebookresearch_npm/npm/model.py.load_single_model_from_local_checkpoint: load a SingleModel from a local PyTorch checkpoint file with state_dict extraction
facebookresearch_npm/npm/model.py.run_single_model_forward_pass: run a forward pass on SingleModel with input_ids and index to get logits and query embeddings
facebookresearch_npm/npm/model.py.load_model_from_hf_hub: load a Model from HuggingFace Hub using checkpoint path like facebook/npm for span prediction
facebookresearch_npm/npm/model.py.run_model_forward_pass: run a forward pass on Model with input_ids and index to get logits and start and end query embeddings

facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm.py.predict_span_NPM: predict answer spans from a query text using the NPM model with configurable alpha values
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm.py.get_all_scores_NPM: compute concatenated start and end scores for query tensors across the document store
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm.py.get_query_NPM: extract the query embedding tensor from an input text containing a mask token
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm.py.evaluate_open_NPM: evaluate open-domain QA predictions against reference answers and print exact match accuracy
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm.py.review_NPM_class: review the NPM class that extends NPMSingle for neural passage retrieval and span prediction

facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm_single.py.predict_NPMSingle: predict label probabilities for input text using the NPMSingle model with a label to id mapping
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm_single.py.evaluate_NPMSingle: evaluate the NPMSingle model on a task dataset and print accuracy metrics
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm_single.py.get_knn_scores_NPMSingle: get k-nearest neighbor scores and optional context for token prediction queries
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm_single.py.init_label2word_id_NPMSingle: initialize a label to word token id mapping from a synonym dictionary
facebookresearch_npm/npm/npm_single.py.get_stopword_mask_NPMSingle: generate a stopword mask array that suppresses specified token ids in the vocabulary

facebookresearch_npm/npm/searcher.py.build_bm25_index: build a BM25 search index from a JSON data directory using pyserini Lucene
facebookresearch_npm/npm/searcher.py.search_bm25_documents: search the BM25 index with a query string and return top k document IDs
facebookresearch_npm/npm/searcher.py.batch_search_bm25: batch search the BM25 index with multiple queries and return lists of document IDs
facebookresearch_npm/npm/searcher.py.batch_search_with_task: batch search using a Task object to retrieve restricted document indices for examples
facebookresearch_npm/npm/searcher.py.batch_search_with_dict: batch search using a precomputed dictionary of string to document ID mappings
